mĕtoecus , i, m., = μέτοικος,
I.a stranger, sojourner, denizen, resident alien dwelling in a city without the rights of citizenship (post-class.), Eum. Pan. Flavens. Nom. Dict. 4 fin.: “ager militi metoeco (al. modico) est assignatus,” Front. de Colon. p. 134 Goes. (written mĕtycus , Gromat. Vet. 234, 19; 238, 7 Lachm.).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
